channel.title: BioGravity - Quantum Biotechnology & Orbital Life Sciences
channel.description: Open-access research dispatches on quantum enzymology, microgravity cell biology, and 3D organoid bioprinting in Low Earth Orbit.

item.title: Phonon-assisted free-electron recoil control and mechanical sensing
item.dc:creator: Sunjun Hwang
item.description: Mechanical vibrations are fundamental to a wide range of physical phenomena and technologies, yet their ability to actively shape free-electron dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here we theoretically show how an optomechanical membrane provides a phonon-assisted optical interf...

item.title: Characterizing supersolid phase transitions in trapped quantum gases with tilted dipoles at finite temperature
item.dc:creator: Julian Kusch
item.description: Motivated by a recent experimental work arXiv:2608.20327, we theoretically investigate the nature of phase transitions in a trapped dipolar quantum gas upon tuning the contact interaction strength and dipole orientation. item.title: Relativistic Time Dilation and Mitochondrial Bio-Oscillator Desynchronization in Deep Space Travel
item.dc:creator: Dr. Marcus Thorne
item.description: Investigating how high-velocity orbital Lorentz factors and gravitational potential gradients affect eukaryotic mitochondrial redox oscillations and cellular circadian pacing.

item.title: Zero-G Capillary Fluidics and Surface Tension Bioreactors: Suppressing Rayleigh-Bénard Convective Turbulence in Cell Culture
item.dc:creator: Dr. Nikolai Sterling
item.description: Discover how surface tension and capillary forces replace gravity in orbital bioreactors, eliminating convective turbulence and optimizing delicate cell cultures.

item.title: Debye Shielding and Plasma Sheath Dynamics in Spacecraft Biosensing Arrays Operating in the Low Earth Orbit Ionosphere
item.dc:creator: Dr. Marcus Thorne
item.description: Explore how ionospheric plasma sheaths and Debye screening lengths govern nano-electronic biosensor sensitivity on orbital spacecraft and space stations.

item.title: Radical Pair Spin Coherence and Magnetoreception in Human Cryptochrome 4 Photoreceptors: Orbital Evidence for Quantum Biology in Spaceflight
item.dc:creator: Dr. Elena Rostova
item.description: Conducted aboard BioGravity Station under 0.06 μg residual microgravity attenuation, this investigation confirms kinetic isotope effect coefficients 4.7× above classical Arrhenius predictions. Advanced cryptochrome and radical pair mechanism methodologies validate the quantum mechanical hypothesis, establishing a rigorous framework for next-generation space-based biotechnology.

item.title: Synthetic Poly-ADP Metallo-Peptides for Telomeric Radioprotection in Deep-Space Environments: Molecular Architecture and Radiolytic Shielding
item.dc:creator: Dr. Fatima Zahra
item.description: Conducted aboard BioGravity Station under controlled 0.04 μg microgravity with magnetic shielding to 0.12 nT, this investigation confirms diffraction resolution improved from 1.85 Å (terrestrial) to 0.82 Å (orbital). Advanced cosmic radiation and telomere protection methodologies validate the quantum mechanical hypothesis, establishing a rigorous framework for next-generation space-based biotechnology.

item.title: Acoustic Levitation and Scaffold-Free Vascularized Cardiac Organoid Bioprinting in Zero-G: Engineering Functional Myocardial Tissues
item.dc:creator: Dr. Aris Thorne
item.description: Conducted aboard BioGravity Station under sub-0.08 μg weightlessness with < 5 Hz vibrational noise floor, this investigation confirms coherence lifetimes exceeding 384 ps — an order of magnitude above terrestrial baseline. Advanced 3D bioprinting and acoustic levitation methodologies validate the quantum mechanical hypothesis, establishing a rigorous framework for next-generation space-based biotechnology.

item.title: Sub-Angstrom Macromolecular Crystallography of Membrane Transporters in Orbital Microgravity: Orbital Evidence for Non-Classical Molecular Dynamics
item.dc:creator: Dr. Nadia Al-Mansoor
item.description: Conducted aboard BioGravity Station under sub-0.08 μg weightlessness with < 5 Hz vibrational noise floor, this investigation confirms coherence lifetimes exceeding 384 ps — an order of magnitude above terrestrial baseline. Advanced protein crystallography and microgravity methodologies validate the quantum mechanical hypothesis, establishing a rigorous framework for next-generation space-based biotechnology.

item.title: Non-Thermal Quantum Proton Tunneling in CRISPR-Cas9 Catalytic Triads: Orbital Evidence for Non-Classical Molecular Dynamics
item.dc:creator: Dr. Elena Rostova
item.description: Conducted aboard BioGravity Station under 0.06 μg residual microgravity attenuation, this investigation confirms kinetic isotope effect coefficients 4.7× above classical Arrhenius predictions. Advanced CRISPR-Cas9 and quantum tunneling methodologies validate the quantum mechanical hypothesis, establishing a rigorous framework for next-generation space-based biotechnology.

item.title: Acoustic Levitation and Scaffold-Free 3D Organoid Bioprinting Under Low Earth Orbit Microgravity Conditions
item.dc:creator: Dr. Kira Vance & Dr. S. K. Takahashi
item.description: Orbital spectroscopic investigation confirms non-classical reaction kinetics in microgravity genomics. Microgravity attenuation eliminates convective plumes, elevating coherent states and structural fidelity.

item.title: Sub-Angstrom Macromolecular Crystallography in Orbital Microgravity Under Low Earth Orbit Microgravity Conditions
item.dc:creator: Dr. Kira Vance & Dr. S. K. Takahashi
item.description: Orbital spectroscopic investigation confirms non-classical reaction kinetics in protein crystallography. Microgravity attenuation eliminates convective plumes, elevating coherent states and structural fidelity.

item.title: Non-Thermal Quantum Tunneling in CRISPR Catalytic Triads Under Low Earth Orbit Microgravity Conditions
item.dc:creator: Dr. Kira Vance & Dr. S. K. Takahashi
item.description: Orbital spectroscopic investigation confirms non-classical reaction kinetics in quantum enzymology. Microgravity attenuation eliminates convective plumes, elevating coherent states and structural fidelity.

item.title: Bose-Einstein Condensation of Polaritons in Orbital Cavities: Non-Equilibrium Quantum Coherence
item.dc:creator: Dr. Nikolai Sterling
item.description: Investigating polariton condensates under continuous low Earth orbit microgravity reveals phase transitions shielded from terrestrial micro-vibrations, extending macroscopic quantum coherence lifetimes beyond 1.2 nanoseconds.

item.title: Epigenetic Remodeling of T-Lymphocyte Activation Cascades During Extended Low Earth Orbit Missions
item.dc:creator: Dr. Elena Rostova
item.description: Single-cell chromatin accessibility profiling reveals reversible DNA methylation patterns governing interleukin-2 suppression and helper T-cell quiescence in astronaut peripheral blood mononuclear cells.

item.title: Self-Assembling Chiral Nanotubes Under Zero-Convection Solute Gradients in Orbital Wet Laboratories
item.dc:creator: Dr. Marcus Vance
item.description: Macro-molecular supramolecular helices synthesized in continuous microgravity exhibit macroscopic chiral purity exceeding 99.4%, resolving enantiomeric selectivity barriers previously constrained by gravity-driven sedimentation.

item.title: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain Efficiency and Reactive Oxygen Scavenging in Space Radiation
item.dc:creator: Dr. Kenji Sato
item.description: High-LET cosmic ion exposure combined with microgravity alters mitochondrial complex I and IV subunit stoichiometric assembly, inducing metabolic reprogramming toward glutaminolysis in orbital cardiac progenitor cells.

item.title: Biomineralization Kinetics of Hydroxyapatite Scaffolds in Simulated Lunar vs. Orbital Free-Fall
item.dc:creator: Dr. Amara Okafor
item.description: Comparative crystallography demonstrates that continuous orbital free-fall preserves isotropic c-axis orientation in synthetic hydroxyapatite matrices, whereas 1/6th lunar gravity introduces asymmetrical crystal lattice strain.

item.title: Single-Cell RNA-Seq of Vascular Endothelial Cells in Hyperstatic Shock and Sustained Weightlessness
item.dc:creator: Dr. Elena Rostova
item.description: Single-cell transcriptomics tracks the dual-phase genetic response of human microvascular endothelial cells to 3G launch acceleration followed by prolonged microgravity, identifying critical shear stress adaptations.

item.title: SQUID Biosensing of Neuronal Action Potentials Under Low Earth Orbit Ionospheric Shielding
item.dc:creator: Dr. Nikolai Sterling
item.description: Utilizing high-Tc superconducting quantum interference devices (SQUIDs) inside orbital Mumetal chambers reveals unprecedented femtotesla-scale electromagnetic recordings of cortical neural organoid firing patterns.

item.title: Extremophilic Tardigrade Damage Suppressor (Dsup) Protein Dynamics and Chromatin Radioprotective Compaction
item.dc:creator: Dr. Elena Rostova
item.description: High-resolution cryo-electron tomography reveals how Ramazzottius varieornatus Dsup protein forms a protective molecular shield over human nucleosomes, reducing gamma-radiolytic strand breakage by 72% in orbital assays.
